in_sanskrit.name: इन्द्राज
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The ruler or the king of the celestial beings, the god of rain, thunderbolt, and the sky. He is the chief deity of the Vedic religion.

in_marathi.name: Indraj
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of Indra, King of Gods
in_marathi.long_meaning: Indraj हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Indraj is a name derived from Sanskrit, meaning 'Lord of Indra' or 'King of Gods'.
